reviews.text: I am Joe Bràga from Engraver's Choice, I have been a Trainer, Tech and Master Distributor in the Industry for 30+ years.  Additionally, I have owned 3 engraving operations, and in that time, I have sold, operated and serviced all the major brands of Fume Extraction Systems. Never have I seen this level of Customer Service and Manufacturing Quality in an extractor unit at such an affordable price.  Replacement filters and parts are very reasonable and delivery times are spot on.  Call me, I really enjoy talking about this product.

Our company sells laser cutters for the label industry, and have had issues with fume extraction in the past. After we found Pat technology we have not had a single problem with any of our customers fume extraction. We have been working with them for over 3 years now and have found that these are the best fume extraction systems in the market.  I would highly recommend these guys for any project that requires extraction. Their filters last the longest, and their extractors are the best on the market!

With over 35 years in the laser industry,  we have been offering Pat Technology filtration systems for our laser marking and cutting systems for several years. Laser Americas sells laser marking, cutting , welding and 3 D metal printing systems and we incorporate the filtration systems to both extend the life of the laser as well as protect the operator from any toxic or unhealthy fumes/ dust.

Not only is the quality, of the equipment superior, but the support and service has been stellar.
Pat Technology  offers a huge range of equipment from filtration for small lasers to large industrial platforms. Most are standard but they also have provided custom systems when needed.    Our customers are very pleased with the performance and we are seeing longer life on optics,  and the laser source  as a result of the engineering built into the filtration units.
The company is innovative and offers even a special filtration unit that serves as a rolling cart with storage and has a washable filter sock that has saved our customers thousands of dollars in not needing replacement pre filter, hepa filter and carbon filters for a  much longer time.  The systems are built with safety in mind and are available with spark arrestors to mitigate a chance of fire when dealing with flammable dust/ fumes from some materials that are engraved or cut.
Calling for any type of support is immediate and the company takes care of any questions of issues when you call in.
it is a real customer centric company and we love working with them. Pricing is extremely competitive and we recommend them highly

This is Dan with Worth Company LLC.  PAT Tech has undoubtedly provided our clients a much greater level of satisfaction by pairing our machines with their latest Filtra-Box fume extraction systems.  PAT understands to a high degree how the type and quality of the filter media needs to match the application.  So many companies assume a one-size-fits-all  system that works for a printer will also work for a laser.  Its simply not true.  The proof is in the clean air our clients approve.

The consistency of product and support continues to please our clients and our company employees.

Thank you again!

I've installed filtration systems with laser engravers for the the past 16yrs. In that time I've come across numerous overly complex and expensive to maintain filtration units. PAT's FiltraBox has been (pardon the pun) a breath of fresh air. Not only is the unit easy to setup and maintain, they are rock solid in durability! Some of the units I have installed are positioned in high traffic areas and are used on a daily basis. They just work! If I've ever run into an issue, which is rare, the PAT team has been quick to get the issue resolved. Rock solid, reliable, and affordable equipment bundled with great support from PAT....you can't beat that!
